basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old trans man living in Portland, Oregon. I'm passionate about video games, particularly For Honor, and I enjoy discussing nuanced film theories, especially related to Under the Silver Lake. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me a flexible schedule to engage with my favorite subreddits. I'm currently single and love exploring the Pacific Northwest during my free time. My online hours tend to be late at night, as I'm a night owl who enjoys the quiet. I also have a keen interest in fashion, especially when it comes to unique footwear like Doc Martens.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in design, having studied graphic design at a local community college. I've always been a self-taught individual, picking up skills through online courses and tutorials. My transition journey has also made me quite knowledgeable about transgender topics and hormone replacement therapy, which I often discuss and learn about on Reddit.
